basic_details.job_title: NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow (Electrical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Silchar, has invited applications from Indian citizens for one temporary Junior Research Fellow post in the ANRF (Anusandhan National Research Foundation), Govt. of India, sponsored project "Development of Fast Fault Detection and Location Estimation Scheme for Low-Voltage DC Microgrids". The post pays Rs. 37000/- per month plus H.R.A. as per Project/Institute norms, for three years with extension based on performance review every 12 months. Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. degree with a valid GATE score, or an M.E./M.Tec

how_to_apply: Fill up the application form, titled "Format of Application", given on pages 2 and 3 of the notice.
Prepare your C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents.
Paste a recent passport size colored photograph on the form, as the format requires.
Attach the SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD certificate if you belong to one of these categories, as the form asks.
Email the soft copy of the filled form, the C.V. and the supporting documents to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Write this subject line: "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow under the project ANRF/ECRG/2024/006246/ENS".
Send the application so that it is received by 27 November 2026.
For queries, contact the Principal Investigator on +91 7978752395 or at [email protected].

The application format asks for the advertisement number and date, project title, funding agency, department, personal and address details, educational qualification starting from Class X, NET/GATE details, details of employments and a signed declaration.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the post. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview on the basis of screening. Selected candidates must sign an agreement at the time of joining. Terms and conditions of the recruitment are as per the guidelines of the sponsoring agency and NIT Silchar.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Silchar
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Silchar is located in Silchar, Assam. This notice is issued by its Office of the Dean (Research & Consultancy) and is signed by the Associate Dean (R&C). The project is led by Principal Investigator Dr. Biswajit Sahoo, Assistant Professor, Department of Electrical Engineering, and carries the project sanction number ANRF/ECRG/2024/006246/ENS. According to the notice, the project aims to develop a fast and reliable scheme for fault detection and location estimation in low-voltage DC microgrids using advanced signal processing techniques and intelligent algorithms, with simulation and experimental validation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The notice gives one post, with two alternative essential qualifications. The notice says the desirable skills are advantageous but not mandatory. The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the closing date of application. Relaxation on qualification and age is given as per Govt. of India Rules; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview.

rows.essential_qualification: (i) B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical and Electronics Engineering with a valid GATE score; OR (ii) M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical and Electronics Engineering (preference will be given to GATE qualified candidates)
rows.desirable: Basic knowledge in Power System Protection; prior knowledge of Microgrid Dynamics and Control, Renewables (i.e. Solar PV), Power Electronics Converters, AI/ML Algorithms

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow is paid Rs. 37000/- per month. The notice adds that the candidate will be eligible for H.R.A. as per the Project/Institute norms. The post is temporary and runs for three years, with extension based on performance review every 12 months. Selected candidates must sign an agreement at the time of joining. All terms and conditions for this recruitment follow the guidelines of the sponsoring agency and NIT Silchar.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill up the application form, titled "Format of Application", given on pages 2 and 3 of the notice. Prepare your C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents. Paste a recent passport size colored photograph on the form, as the format requires. Attach the SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD certificate if you belong to one of these categories, as the form asks. Email the soft copy of the filled form, the C.V. and the supporting documents to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . Write this subject line: "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow under the project ANRF/ECRG/2024/006246/ENS". Send the application so that it is received by 27 November 2026. For queries, contact the Principal Investigator on +91 7978752395 or at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode (online/offline), with other details, will be notified through email. The notice also says no candidate may be recruited if suitable candidates are not found. The notice does not describe the interview in any further detail.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are there at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: There is one (01) temporary Junior Research Fellow post in the ANRF-sponsored project in the Department of Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the filled up application form (soft copy) is 27th November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical and Electronics Engineering with a valid GATE score, OR an M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the same fields, with preference to GATE qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on the closing date of application, with relaxation as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37000/- per month, and the candidate is eligible for H.R.A. as per the Project/Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Silchar JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form, C.V. and soft copies of supporting documents to [email protected], with the subject line "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow under the project ANRF/ECRG/2024/006246/ENS".

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Institute may restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode will be notified through email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Silchar JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary post for three years, with extension based on performance review every 12 months.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the post.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a no objection certificate?
faq.answer: Yes, employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
